mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS process_id, p.code AS process_code, p.name AS process_name, wm.module_classify AS process_bussiness_key,
r.id AS rule_id, db.name AS rule_type, r.disabled AS rule_disabled, r.create_time AS rule_create_time, r.create_user_name AS rule_create_user_name, r.update_time AS rule_update_time, r.update_user_name AS rule_update_user_name,
CASE WHEN r.type = 'fsProcess' THEN tpd.name WHEN r.type = 'erpProcess' THEN pd.process_name ELSE NULL END AS process_definition_name,
STRING_AGG( CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(e.left_bracket, ''), COALESCE(cqo.condition_field_name, ''), COALESCE(drc.value, ''), COALESCE(e.name, ''), COALESCE(e.right_bracket, ''), COALESCE(e.logic, '') ), '' ORDER BY e.index ) AS aggregated_exp_desc
FROM public.cfg_process p LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_rule r ON p.id = r.cfg_process_id AND r.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.third_process_definition tpd ON r.type = 'fsProcess' AND r.process_definition_id = tpd.approval_code AND tpd.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.process_definition pd ON r.type = 'erpProcess' AND r.process_definition_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = false AND pd.is_deploy = true LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_exp e ON r.id = e.rule_id AND e.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.dict_rule_condition drc ON e.compare = drc.key AND drc.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.cfg_query_option cqo ON p.bussiness_key = cqo.bussiness_key AND e.field = cqo.condition_field AND cqo.is_deleted = false and cqo.use_type = 'cfgProcess' LEFT JOIN public.dict_basic db ON r.type = db.value AND db.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.work_menu wm ON wm.module_code = p.bussiness_key AND wm.is_deleted = false
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} AND p.is_deleted = false
${params.permissionSql}
GROUP BY p.id, p.code, p.name, p.bussiness_key, r.id, r.type, r.disabled, r.create_time, r.create_user_name, r.update_time, r.update_user_name, tpd.name, pd.process_name, wm.module_classify, db.name
ORDER BY p.code DESC, r.create_time ASC

SELECT p.id AS process_id, p.code AS process_code, p.name AS process_name, p.bussiness_key AS process_bussiness_key,
r.id AS rule_id, r.type AS rule_type, r.cfg_process_id AS cfg_process_id, r.process_definition_id AS r_process_definition_id, COALESCE(pd.process_version,0) AS process_definition_version, r.is_default AS is_default, r.disabled AS disabled,
(SELECT STRING_AGG( CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(sub_e.left_bracket, ''), COALESCE(sub_cqo.condition_field_name, ''), COALESCE(sub_drc.value, ''), COALESCE(sub_e.name, ''), COALESCE(sub_e.right_bracket, ''), COALESCE(sub_e.logic, '') ), E'' ORDER BY sub_e.index ASC ) FROM public.cfg_process_exp sub_e LEFT JOIN public.dict_rule_condition sub_drc ON sub_e.compare = sub_drc.key AND sub_drc.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.cfg_query_option sub_cqo ON p.bussiness_key = sub_cqo.bussiness_key AND sub_e.field = sub_cqo.condition_field AND sub_cqo.is_deleted = false and sub_cqo.use_type = 'cfgProcess' WHERE sub_e.rule_id = r.id AND sub_e.is_deleted = false) AS exp_desc,
e.id AS exp_id, e.rule_id AS rule_id_for_exp, e.left_bracket AS left_bracket, e.field AS field, e.field_name AS fieldName, e.compare AS compare, e.value AS value, e.right_bracket AS right_bracket, e.logic AS logic, e.index AS exp_index, e.name AS exp_name,
fm.id AS field_map_id, fm.third_field AS third_field, fm.third_field_type AS third_field_type, fm.third_field_required AS third_field_required, fm.sys_field AS sys_field, fm.sys_field_type AS sys_field_type, fm.sys_field_required AS sys_field_required, fm.cfg_id AS cfg_id, fm.default_value AS field_default_value, fm.is_unique AS is_unique, fm.cfg_type AS cfg_type, fm.third_field_id AS third_field_id, fm.is_detail_field AS is_detail_field, fm.third_parent_id AS third_parent_id, fm.sys_parent_id AS sys_parent_id, fm.group_type AS group_type, fm.index AS index FROM public.cfg_process p LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_rule r ON p.id = r.cfg_process_id AND r.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_exp e ON r.id = e.rule_id AND e.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.cfg_process_field_map fm ON r.id = fm.cfg_id AND fm.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.process_definition pd ON r.process_definition_id = pd.id AND pd.is_deleted = false AND pd.is_deploy = true WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.is_deleted = false ORDER BY p.id ASC, r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC, e.index ASC, e.id ASC, fm.id ASC

SELECT vm.id AS value_map_id, vm.field_map_id AS value_field_map_id, vm.third_value AS third_value, vm.sys_value AS sys_value, vm.default_value AS map_defaultValue FROM public.cfg_process_value_map vm WHERE vm.field_map_id = #{fieldMapId} AND vm.is_deleted = false
